questions.q: Which is the SI unit of molar conductivity?
questions.explanation: Λm = κ / c, so its unit is S m² mol⁻¹.

questions.q: In a galvanic cell, electrons flow from:
options: Cathode to anode inside the cell
Anode to cathode through the external circuit
questions.explanation: Oxidation at the anode releases electrons that travel through the wire to the cathode.

questions.q: What is the standard electrode potential of the standard hydrogen electrode (SHE)?
questions.explanation: By convention, SHE is assigned exactly 0.00 V.

questions.q: The value of the Faraday constant is approximately:
questions.explanation: 1 F = charge on one mole of electrons ≈ 96500 C mol⁻¹.

questions.q: Which of these is a secondary (rechargeable) cell?
questions.explanation: The lead storage battery can be recharged; dry and mercury cells are primary cells.
